主卧.en: My home is on the eighteenth floor, and both the master bedroom and the living room face south.

从今以后.zh: 我从今以后不会再说谎了。
从今以后.pinyin: Wǒ cóng jīn yǐ hòu bù huì zài shuō huǎng le
从今以后.en: I will never tell a lie from now on.
从今以后.es: Ya nunca diré una mentira de ahora en adelante.

偏好.zh: 我偏好结局圆满的小说。
偏好.pinyin: Wǒ piān hào jié jú yuán mǎn de xiǎo shuō
偏好.en: I prefer novels that have a happy ending.
偏好.es: Prefiero las novelas con un final feliz.

先下手为强.zh: 先下手为强，后下手遭殃。
先下手为强.pinyin: Xiān xià shǒu wéi qiáng hòu xià shǒu zāo yāng
先下手为强.en: Get them before they get us.

别具一格.zh: 日本有许多别具一格的特色。
别具一格.pinyin: Rì běn yǒu xǔ duō bié jù yī gé de tè sè

卉.pinyin: Wǒ yào gěi wǒ mā ma yī ge huì
卉.en: I want to give Mom a plant.
卉.es: Quiero regalar una planta a mamá.

叶里温.zh: 叶里温是亚美尼亚的首都。
叶里温.pinyin: Yè lǐ wēn shì yà měi ní yà de shǒu dū

嘉.zh: 我想和格特‧嘉尼一起死。
嘉.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng hé gé tè jiā ní yī qǐ sǐ
嘉.en: I want to die with Getter Jaani.

国度.zh: 现在我们很容易就能乘飞机去遥远的国度。
国度.pinyin: Xiàn zài wǒ men hěn róng yì jiù néng chéng fēi jī qù yáo yuǎn de guó dù
国度.en: Today we can go to distant countries easily by plane.

地下铁.zh: 给我一张地下铁的路线图好吗？
地下铁.pinyin: Gěi wǒ yī zhāng dì xià tiě de lù xiàn tú hǎo ma
地下铁.en: Could I have a subway map, please?
地下铁.es: ¿Puede usted darme el plano del metro, por favor?

埃及学.pinyin: Mǎ lì shì gè āi jí xué jiā

大坑.zh: 我只用一天就用铲子挖了一个大坑。
大坑.pinyin: Wǒ zhǐ yòng yī tiān jiù yòng chǎn zi wā le yī ge dà kēng
大坑.en: I dug a huge pit with my shovel in just one day.

大我.en: He is twice as old as I am.
大我.es: Él es el doble de viejo que yo.

天台.zh: 那座大厦天台的景色很美的，想去看看吗？
天台.pinyin: Nà zuò dà shà tiān tāi de jǐng sè hěn měi dí xiǎng qù kàn kan ma
天台.en: There's a great view from the rooftop of that building. Want to go see?

奉.pinyin: Tā men bǎ tā fèng wèi lǐng xiù
奉.en: They looked up to him as their leader.

婉.zh: 婉君超爱追剧，韩剧、美剧她都看。
婉.pinyin: Wǎn jūn chāo ài zhuī jù hán jù měi jù tā dōu kàn
婉.en: Wan-chun’s a total drama addict — Korean, American, she watches them all.

嬉.pinyin: Guān ài shēng mìng qǐng wù xī shuǐ
嬉.en: For the sake of living things, please do not play around with the water.

安检.zh: 当我们过安检的时候，我从队伍里被拉出来搜身。
安检.pinyin: Dāng wǒ men guo ān jiǎn de shí hou wǒ cóng duì wǔ lǐ bèi lā chū lái sōu shēn
安检.en: When we were going through security, I got pulled out of line for a pat-down.

宕机.pinyin: Fú wù qì dàng jī le

小川.pinyin: Nǐ hǎo nǐ shì xiǎo chuān xiān sheng ma
小川.es: Buenos días, ¿es usted el señor Ogawa?

小白.zh: 我们给我们的狗取名叫小白。
小白.pinyin: Wǒ men gěi wǒ men de gǒu qǔ míng jiào xiǎo bái

尽皆.zh: 听到这件悲剧，他俩尽皆哭泣。
尽皆.pinyin: Tīng dào zhè jiàn bēi jù tā liǎ jìn jiē kū qì
尽皆.en: They both cried after hearing the tragic news.

屏蔽.zh: 但愿我能找到在我的博客上屏蔽评论的办法。
屏蔽.pinyin: Dàn yuàn wǒ néng zhǎo dào zài wǒ de bó kè shàng píng bì píng lùn de bàn fǎ
屏蔽.en: I wish I could figure out how to disable comments on my blog.
屏蔽.es: Me gustaría averiguar cómo desactivar comentarios en mi blog.

巫术.zh: 巫术在原始社会扮演重要角色。
巫术.pinyin: Wū shù zài yuán shǐ shè huì bàn yǎn zhòng yào jué sè
巫术.en: Magic plays an important part in primitive society.
巫术.es: La magia juega un papel importante en las sociedades primitivas.

弃权.pinyin: Tāng mǔ tóu piào qì quán

悉.zh: 神话让我们能透悉古文明。
悉.pinyin: Shén huà ràng wǒ men néng tòu xī gǔ wén míng
悉.en: The myth offers insights into the ancient civilization.
悉.es: Leyendo esa leyenda se puede comprender con profundidad la civilización antigua.
